instructions: SEION Music Lab is a local-first AI-assisted music production lab for FL Studio.
The MVP must run fully offline using deterministic Python music generation.
Do not require LLM API calls for the core `seion-music generate` command.
All internal objects are Pydantic models defined in app/schemas.
Music theory lives in app/music, scoring in app/seion, export in app/export.
Every musical decision must be explainable and every track must be editable.
